## Où j'en suis
Staging (`analytics-staging`) has run PostgreSQL 17.2 since 14:20 UTC on Nov 17, after the pg_partman 5.1.0 upgrade and the blue/green switchover (41 s of refused writes). The dbt run passed 14/14. Draft PR #57 is still open with commits 7e3c9d4 and b0f18a2. The runbook is updated. Prod has no date and is waiting for Maya's sign-off after a full week of staging on 17. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] Staging soak on 17.2: a full week is required, so the earliest sign-off is Nov 24. (source: ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] After Maya's sign-off, pick the prod window outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock. Two windows are needed: first the reboot for `rds.logical_replication = 1`, then the blue/green switchover. (source: ses-pg-3, src-slack-infra, ses-pg-1)
- [prochaine-étape] Keep `apply_immediately` false and prod behind `pg17_enabled = false` until then. (source: s1-04, ses-pg-1)
- [essai-raté] The first staging apply failed because the source 16.4 parameter group lacked `rds.logical_replication = 1`, a static parameter that needs a reboot. It was fixed by adding the parameter and rebooting (1m48s). (source: s3-04, s3-06)
- [question] The prod window is not set. The Nov 28, 04:00 UTC date in the agent note was never approved by the user, who said no prod date until Maya signs off. (source: s1-04, src-note-cutover)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off. (source: s1-04, s3-09)
- [décision] The AWS provider stays pinned to 5.82, with no v6 in this PR. (source: s1-02)
